summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a press release and half-year report for H1 2026, reporting revenue of $11.2 million (up 131% YoY), gross profit of $5.4 million, operating loss of $32.2 million, and a net loss of $27.8 million. Cash and equivalents totaled $486.1 million. FY2026 revenue guidance of $27-$36 million was reaffirmed. The filing discusses integration of IC Alps SAS, acquired in August 2025, and a pipeline exceeding $225 million. This is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
